resources.string: Transparent, controllable NFC-F profile emulation for Android.

AimeSimulator is an independently implemented Android NFC-F / FeliCa Lite profile manager and HCE-F emulator. It stores local card profiles, captures the required data from physical cards, and presents the selected profile through Android’s NFC service.

• Multiple local profiles and physical-card capture
• Normal and compatibility NFCID2 routing
• Standard HCE-F PMm declaration
• Optional LSPosed / KernelSU vendor compatibility patches
• Material You dynamic colors and light/dark themes

Profiles remain in the app’s private storage. Android backup is disabled, and the app requests no network permission and includes no telemetry, account, or cloud sync. Hiding an IDm or printed Access Code affects only its display.

Use only with cards and devices you own or are authorized to test. Selecting this app as the default NFC app replaces the existing contactless payment app. Root, LSPosed, and KernelSU patches also modify the NFC runtime; keep a recovery path available.

This project was independently implemented from public Android interfaces and observable behavior. It contains no source or prebuilt library from the earlier project. Aime, FeliCa, and related names and marks belong to their respective owners. This unofficial compatibility and research tool is not affiliated with or endorsed by them.
